Name: Devourwulf Characters (WIP)

Description:
[b]Devourwulf Characters -
[/b]This mod changes the base characters for replayability. Portraits are in anime style. Not finished.

[b]Project Goals
[/b]Redo characters/portraits
Add different outfit/portrait for character by season day
Bonus clothing - chance of unique clothing occur in event ex. Festival than set
Create new events - festivals, quests, more dialogues
Create new items - spinach, lettuce, etc


[b]Next Patch - 
[/b]Adding sample NPCS
Sample will just have recolored set1 outfit for seasonal and winter different for now
That way I can get this project moving then will add more like example Maru is.

Next update: ETA August

[b]Notes:[/b]
Caught up in multiple projects. Project still moving forward. I'll try an update monthly until its fully complete. I get bombarded with questions on how to do stuff on stellaris modding section, servers, SQL, python, Linux, and etc.
